title: 便利店“升仓”了
content: Internet giants are converting storefronts into 24/7 online-only "convenience store warehouses" for instant retail, with Taobao and Meituan each operating 700+ hidden, non-street-facing locations carrying 5,000-10,000 SKUs. Unlike past "new retail" attempts to capture offline traffic, this model treats stores purely as fulfillment infrastructure. Traditional convenience stores face eroding advantages of proximity and speed as 30-minute delivery becomes normalized, while struggling with declining foot traffic and thinner profits despite joining platforms. The winners will be those who balance rapid warehouse-network expansion with sustainable unit economics.

title: 思科2000-2021年复盘
content: Cisco's 2000-2001 case study reveals key bubble dynamics: stock peaked March 2000, but fundamentals topped 8-12 months later. Financing collapse preceded order collapse by 8 months; share prices tracked credit markets, not demand data. Delayed capex execution and vendor financing obscured true demand, which then evaporated violently. Management only acknowledged weakness after an 80% drawdown. Reliable leading indicators include: financing source shifts (internal to debt/equity), supplier financing of customers, and government/return-insensitive capital entering late—all extending overcapacity and peak heights.

title: Kimi K3与DeepSeek V4之间，隔着原生多模态的时间差
content: Chinese AI firms are split on native multimodal integration. Moonshot's Kimi K3 (2.8T parameters) and Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max prioritize early visual-text fusion for coding and agent tasks, enabling "vision in the loop" where models directly perceive and adjust based on visual feedback. DeepSeek's V4-Flash takes the opposite approach, achieving competitive coding performance through optimized post-training without native multimodal capabilities or massive parameter scaling. The divide reflects timing and resource tradeoffs rather than strategic disagreement: integrating vision risks diluting language and reasoning capabilities, requires disproportionate training costs, and demands complex data balancing. Industry consensus holds coding competence as table stakes; multimodal integration remains secondary despite its long-term importance for agent autonomy.

Founded in 2016 after Musk was stuck in traffic, the company aims to reduce tunneling costs and build underground vehicle networks to ease urban congestion. Its only operational project, the LVCC Loop in Las Vegas, uses Tesla vehicles to shuttle passengers through short tunnels. The company faces challenges including safety incidents, environmental violations, and the slow pace of infrastructure regulation.

title: 「电子监工」三姐妹，把中产榨干了？
content: Middle-class Chinese workers are increasingly adopting lightweight wearable health devices—smart rings, bracelets, and watches—to monitor vital signs around the clock, driven by anxiety over chronic illness and sudden death in high-pressure jobs. Originally popularized by athletes and celebrities, these "electronic overseers" have become status symbols of "anti-aging" discipline. However, frequent data checking often worsens anxiety rather than health, with some users obsessively managing metrics to their own detriment. Manufacturers now prioritize comfort and subscription-based revenue models over one-time sales, while intense competition has squeezed hardware profits to minimal levels.

title: 瑞幸：走出“外卖后遗症”，“小蓝杯”开启顺风局？
content: Luckin Coffee's Q2 2026 earnings beat expectations with revenue of 15.89 billion yuan, up 28.5% year-over-year. The company added 2,714 net stores, reaching 36,310 total, prioritizing market share over short-term profitability. Same-store sales declined 5.3%, less than feared, as higher average selling prices offset volume decreases. Monthly transacting users hit a record 113 million. Delivery costs fell 3.1% year-over-year for the first time since the delivery war began, improving profitability. Store-level margins remained resilient at 21.3%. The company launched its bottled ready-to-drink business to expand brand presence and block lower-priced competitors, though competition from both Cotti and tea brands entering coffee remains a concern.

title: OpenAI 发布报告：Astra 模型攻克十项数学难题
content: OpenAI reports that its next-generation model Astra has solved ten long-standing problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, with all proofs formally verified in Lean. The results cover ten areas including group theory and high-dimensional geometry, featuring the first construction of non-sofic groups and breakthroughs in sphere packing density. The papers have not undergone peer review, and authorship remains under discussion. The mathematical community suggests the advances may reshape how problems are posed and verified, though long-term impact depends on further review and replication.
